document_name: Fayda digital identity / Fayda Identification Number (FIN)
issuer_name_english: National ID Program, Ethiopia
issuer_role: Legal issuing authority or responsible national identity authority (see source and notes).
api_or_service_name: Fayda Digital ID SSO API / eSignet OIDC / VeriFayda authentication
verification_mechanism: Online authentication APIs using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC); e-KYC flow requests FAN or FIN and uses holder OTP consent. Offline verification via Fayda QR credential is also documented.
api_access_class: PARTNER_ONBOARDING_REQUIRED; API DOCUMENTATION AND PARTNER PORTAL PUBLISHED
authentication_method: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect; relying-party registration and credentials through partner portal.
authorization_or_consent_requirements: Fayda e-KYC flow requires the holder to receive and provide an OTP verification code to consent before service providers retrieve e-KYC data.
agreement_or_eligibility_requirements: Organization must register through the Fayda Partner Portal; NIDP reviews the onboarding request and provides credentials and technical integration documentation.
verification_capabilities: Online identity authentication; e-KYC data retrieval following holder OTP consent; offline QR-based credential verification. Exact attribute and status coverage must be confirmed in partner documentation.
technical_limitations: Partner-only technical materials and credentials; not an unrestricted anonymous lookup API. API availability does not establish passport issuance/status verification.
review_notes: Official Fayda pages explicitly describe a developer API, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, e-KYC with holder OTP consent, and partner onboarding. This is a genuine API integration candidate, subject to partner approval. Fayda is a foundational resident digital ID, not a passport or proof of citizenship.
